directive_section: Phase B — prove the new UI on the real deployment

deployment.note: verified via GET /api/health before the acceptance run: engine_commit == build_artifact_commit == render_git_commit == d12fce54 (the exact pushed r416/honest-causes-evolution-v1 SHA; no force-push; PR #3 open)

the_test.method: real browser (agent-browser/Playwright) against the PUBLIC deployment, fresh user session, fresh problem
the_test.problem: make a solar panel which is the most efficient in the world
the_test.duration_note: the run worked the problem live: standard chain -> GEN 1 challenged and killed -> GEN 2 evolved and re-evaluated -> honest stop

CHALLENGING_ARCHITECTURE_visible.found: Challenging architecture 1 (phase bar) + 'Challenged and killed at the gauntlet / at independent_attack' (generation records)

forward_progress_to_generation_2.found: Testing architecture 2 (phase bar, live during the run) + the What changed? panel on GEN 2 with the full causal delta (new capability, new interaction, new operating regime, frontier transfer)

honest_maturity_visible.found: GEN 1 EVIDENCE_SUPPORTED; GEN 2 CURRENT · GENERATED; 'the verification gates decide maturity, never the wording'

user_always_sees_forward_progress.evidence: the terminal presents 'Invention 2 generations explored — the current architecture (GEN 2) is presented with its honest maturity' — never a dead end

the_observed_lineage.fate: killed by the standard adversarial chain (weak_transfer, obvious_combination KILLED dimensions); diagnosed cause: adversarial kill

the_observed_lineage.architecture: molecular-scale energy storage (quantum-dot supercapacitor) with the high-efficiency panel
the_observed_lineage.causal_delta: molecular-scale storage and conversion; frontier transfer from energy storage/conversion; new operating regime
the_observed_lineage.fate: killed by the independent adversarial attack — the same diagnosed cause as GEN 1, so the information-gain stop rule ended the loop honestly

honesty_note: nothing in this run was mocked, staged, or hardcoded: the deployed engine really retrieved 18 evidence records from 8 live sources, really killed GEN 1 in the adversarial chain, really generated and re-evaluated GEN 2, and really reported the information-gain stop. The outcome (INVENTION_UNDER_DEVELOPMENT, maturity GENERATED) is the honest one — no generation survived the uncalibrated gauntlet, and nothing was softened (Art. LXVIII). The attacker-calibration standing note (Art. L) is the top priority for the next round.
